title: Discussing the Experiments We Are Going to Try

cues.en: Now we've discussed what kind of experiments should you run?
cues.zh: 現在討論過應該執行哪種實驗。

cues.en: Let's map out the experiments we're going to try.
cues.zh: 來規劃要嘗試的實驗。

cues.en: What experiments are we going to run?
cues.zh: 我們要執行什麼實驗？

cues.en: So in light of all these, we could test all of these things, but we're going to keep it simple.
cues.zh: 依照這些選項，可以全部測，不過先保持簡單。

cues.en: And I want you to start imagining every little hyper parameter, every setting in a machine learning experiment could be like a little dial.
cues.zh: 希望你開始想像，機器學習實驗的每個超參數、每個設定，都是一個小旋鈕。

cues.en: So we're going to turn three dials here.
cues.zh: 這裡要轉三個旋鈕。

cues.en: We're going to turn three dials.
cues.zh: 轉三個旋鈕。

cues.en: And the first one is model size.
cues.zh: 第一，模型大小。

cues.en: The second one is dataset size, and the third one is training time.
cues.zh: 第二，資料集大小；第三，訓練時間。

cues.en: So in lieu of model size, we might use efficient net B0 versus efficient net B2 and data set size.
cues.zh: 模型大小，可能用 EfficientNet-B0 對比 EfficientNet-B2；資料集大小，

cues.en: We might use 10% of pizza, steak, sushi images.
cues.zh: 可能用披薩牛排壽司影像的 10%，

cues.en: Verse.
cues.zh: 對比，

cues.en: 20% and for training time.
cues.zh: 20%；訓練時間，

cues.en: We've trained a lot of models for five epochs, so we might go five epochs versus ten epochs.
cues.zh: 已經訓練很多模型 5 個週期，所以可能比較 5 個與 10 個。

cues.en: And now, of course, we are definitely not limited to just running these, but in my experience, these
cues.zh: 當然，不只限於這些，不過我的經驗，這，

cues.en: three factors are often some of the biggest influences of your model results.
cues.zh: 三個因素通常是對模型結果影響最大的因素之一。

cues.en: So model size, this is in terms of number of parameters.
cues.zh: 模型大小，是參數數量。

cues.en: And this is data set size, so generally more data.
cues.zh: 資料集大小，一般更多資料，

cues.en: Equals better results and generally longer training time.
cues.zh: 等於更好結果；一般更長訓練時間，

cues.en: Equals better results up to a point.
cues.zh: 在某個程度之前，等於更好結果。

cues.en: So that's a little caveat there, is that you might think, well, why are we stopping at ten epochs?
cues.zh: 這裡有個前提，你可能想，為什麼停在 10 個週期？

cues.en: Why don't we do 10,000 epochs?
cues.zh: 為什麼不 10,000 個？

cues.en: Well, generally it, it goes say you wanted to train for ten epochs.
cues.zh: 一般來說，假設訓練 10 個，

cues.en: If you train for 20 epochs, you might get better results.
cues.zh: 改訓練 20 個，結果可能更好。

cues.en: But if you train for 100 epochs, your results might start to degrade.
cues.zh: 但訓練 100 個，結果可能開始退步。

cues.en: So up to a point, but.
cues.zh: 所以有個限度，不過，

cues.en: To begin.
cues.zh: 一開始，

cues.en: We're still keeping things relatively small so that our experiments run quickly.
cues.zh: 還是保持相對小規模，讓實驗跑得快。

cues.en: Now, that's a very important point.
cues.zh: 這是重要重點。

cues.en: We don't want to be waiting here all day for different modeling experiments to run.
cues.zh: 不想在這裡等各種建模實驗跑一整天。

cues.en: We want to quickly test a bunch of different things, such as model size, data, set size and training time and see what is worth pursuing.
cues.zh: 想快速測不同模型大小、資料集大小、訓練時間，看看什麼值得繼續。

cues.en: So if we're waiting here for hours, it's going to take us a long time to figure out what doesn't work.
cues.zh: 如果在這裡等幾小時，就要花很久才知道什麼無效。

cues.en: So why did I pick efficient net b0 versus B2?
cues.zh: 為什麼選 EfficientNet-B0 和 B2？

cues.en: Well, if we come in to the torch vision documentation.
cues.zh: 到 torchvision 文件。

cues.en: And then if we go here, you could truly pick almost any of these models to compare against each other.
cues.zh: 然後到這裡，其實幾乎任意模型都能互相比較。

cues.en: But I've decided to stick within the efficient net family efficient net B0 and there's B1 B1 again with V two weights and there's B2 here.
cues.zh: 但我決定留在 EfficientNet 家族，EfficientNet-B0，有 B1、用 V2 權重的 B1，還有 B2。

cues.en: The reason I've decided on B0 and B2 is because B2 is about double the size, not exactly double the size, but it's close enough.
cues.zh: 選 B0 與 B2，是因為 B2 大約兩倍大，不是精確兩倍，不過夠接近。

cues.en: We could do B3, we could do before we could do B five.
cues.zh: 可以用 B3、B4、B5。

cues.en: But recall what is our overall goal of our Food Vision Mini?
cues.zh: 不過記得 FoodVision Mini 的整體目標？

cues.en: We'd like to build a model that's not too big so that we could deploy it to a website or a mobile device.
cues.zh: 希望模型不要太大，能部署到網站或行動裝置。

cues.en: Because if someone is taking a photo of their food, they're probably going to do it on their phone.
cues.zh: 因為拍食物照片，大概會用手機。

cues.en: So we can't use a model that has a ridiculous number of parameters.
cues.zh: 所以不能用參數多到誇張的模型。

cues.en: Although it may perform better, it might not fit on a mobile device such as this big model here.
cues.zh: 雖然表現可能更好，但行動裝置可能放不下，像這裡這個大型模型。

cues.en: It's got 600 million parameters versus our 5 million for efficient net B zero and 9 million for efficient net B2.
cues.zh: 有 6 億個參數，相較 EfficientNet-B0 的 500 萬，以及 B2 的 900 萬。

cues.en: So in lieu of all that, let's check out the keynote.
cues.zh: 考慮完這些，來看簡報。

cues.en: What experiments should you try?
cues.zh: 應試什麼實驗？

cues.en: Model architecture.
cues.zh: 模型架構。

cues.en: This is what we're going to be trying, tweaking this style.
cues.zh: 要試著調整這個旋鈕。

cues.en: We're going to be tweaking the epoch style and we're also going to be tweaking the amount of data dial.
cues.zh: 調整訓練週期旋鈕，也調整資料量旋鈕。

cues.en: Now, of course, we could try these other things here, but I'm going to leave that to you to explore, such as tweaking the learning rate over time or adding in data augmentation.
cues.zh: 當然也能試這裡其他事情，不過留給你探索，例如隨時間調整學習率，或加入資料增強。

cues.en: So let's get an overview of what we're going to be running.
cues.zh: 看看要執行什麼的概覽。

cues.en: We've got experiment number here, the training data.
cues.zh: 這裡有實驗編號、訓練資料。

cues.en: We're using the testing data.
cues.zh: 使用的測試資料。

cues.en: Something to note here is that we're going to be using the same test set for every experiment.
cues.zh: 注意，每個實驗都會用同一個測試集。

cues.en: That way we can compare apples to apples.
cues.zh: 這樣才能在相同基準比較。

cues.en: If we use a different test set for every experiment, well, then it's hard to really evaluate which experiment did the best.
cues.zh: 如果每個實驗用不同測試集，就難以真正評估哪個最好。

cues.en: So we start off with 10% training data.
cues.zh: 所以從 10% 訓練資料開始。

cues.en: So just the experiment that we've already run, efficient net B0 for five epochs, then we keep the data set the same.
cues.zh: 也就是已經跑過的實驗，EfficientNet-B0 訓練 5 個週期；再保持資料集不變。

cues.en: We change the model, we keep the epochs the same, use efficient net B to.
cues.zh: 更換模型，週期數不變，使用 EfficientNet-B2。

cues.en: Then we train with 10% training data.
cues.zh: 然後再次用 10% 訓練資料。

cues.en: Again, use efficient net B0 just like one and ten epochs, and we slowly start working towards number
cues.zh: 像第一個一樣用 EfficientNet-B0，但訓練 10 個週期，慢慢走向這裡第，

cues.en: eight here, which ends up being double the amount of training data as experiment one, double the model
cues.zh: 8 個；它的訓練資料是第一個的兩倍，模型，

cues.en: size or thereabouts as experiment one and double the amount of epochs.
cues.zh: 大小也是大約兩倍，訓練週期數也是兩倍。

cues.en: So do you see the trend that we're following here?
cues.zh: 看出遵循的趨勢了嗎？

cues.en: We're slowly increasing as we go.
cues.zh: 隨進程慢慢增加。

cues.en: So hopefully running these experiments is going to show us some insight into which one of these combinations works the best.
cues.zh: 所以，希望這些實驗能讓我們了解，哪個組合最有效。

cues.en: Now, if you had to bet, if you had to guess of all these experiments, what do you think is going to perform the best?
cues.zh: 如果要下注、要猜，所有實驗裡哪個表現最好？

cues.en: Will it be a smaller model trained for longer, or will it be a model that has more data, more parameters, and train for the longest?
cues.zh: 小模型訓練久一點，還是資料更多、參數更多、訓練最久的模型？

cues.en: I'll leave that to you to think about.
cues.zh: 留給你想想。

cues.en: But let's now, in the next video, start to prepare our data set.
cues.zh: 不過下支影片，開始準備資料集。

cues.en: So we need a 10% training data data set and a 20% training data set.
cues.zh: 需要 10% 訓練資料集，以及 20% 訓練資料集。

cues.en: I'll see you in the next video.
cues.zh: 下支影片見。
